data.name: Jorge
data.gender_notes: Jorge is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Georgos', meaning 'farmer' or 'earthworker'. This name became popular in Europe due to the reverence for St. George, a martyr and dragon-slayer. The name Jorge carries the meaning “farmer, earthworker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jorge usually hope their child will grow to embody farmer, earthworker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents strength, courage, and protection against adversity.
data.etymology: Jorge belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “farmer, earthworker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jorge total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: חורחה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם חורחה מקורו בשם העברי יהורחם, שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא המושיע' או 'ה' המושיע'. השם יהורחם מורכב משתי מילים: יהו, שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו-רחם, שפירושו 'לרחם' או 'להושיע'. השם חורחה הוא גרסה מקוצרת של השם יהורחם, והוא נמצא בשימוש נרחב בתרבויות שונות, כולל הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Χόρχε
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χόρχε προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα יהורחם (Yehorham), που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι Σωτήρ' ή 'Ο Κύριος είναι Σωτήρ'. Το όνομα יהורחם αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: יהו (Yahweh), που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και רחם (raham), που σημαίνει 'να λυπηθεί' ή 'να σώσει'. Το όνομα Χόρχε είναι μια συντομογραφία του ονόματος יהורחם και έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί ευρέως σε διάφορες κουλτούρες, συμπεριλαμβανομένης της Χριστιανικής παράδοσης.

in_latin.name: Jorge
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jorge derivatur ex nomine hebraico יהורחם (Yehorham), quod significat 'Deus est Salvator' vel 'Dominus est Salvator'. Nomen יהורחם constat ex duobus verbis: יהו (Yahweh), quod significat 'Deus' et רחם (raham), quod significat 'misereri' vel 'salvare'. Nomen Jorge est forma abbreviata nominis יהורחם et in variis culturis, etiam in traditione Christiana, usitatum est.

in_english.name: Jorge
in_english.meaning: God is Savior or Lord is Savior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jorge originates from the Hebrew name יהורחם (Yehorham), meaning 'God is Savior' or 'Lord is Savior'. It is derived from two words: יהו (Yahweh), meaning 'God' and רחם (raham), meaning 'to have mercy' or 'to save'. Jorge is a shortened form of יהורחם and has been adopted in various cultures, including Christian tradition, symbolizing divine salvation and redemption through faith.

data.cultural_impact: Jorge is a common name among the Spanish and Portuguese people, especially in Latin America. Its usage can be traced back to the time of the Roman Empire when St. George was venerated by many as a protector of farmers and herdsmen, making the name synonymous with hard work, perseverance and relate to the agricultural community.
data.spiritual_significance: Jorge is a name rooted in Christian faith, inspired by St. George, a third-century martyr and soldier renowned for his bravery, dedication to Christianity, and the miraculous salvation of his people. To bear this name is a reminder to maintain unwavering faith, strength in the face of adversity and to always stand up for one's beliefs.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jorge, meaning "farmer" in Old Portuguese, symbolizes the steadfast and grounded nature of a Christian. Spiritually, it represents the calling to nurture and cultivate the seeds of faith, growing the Church and spreading God's love.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Born in 1942 in Argentina, Jorge Mario Bergoglio became Pope Francis I in 2013. The name Jorge carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jorge remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Jorge, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Jorge meaning "farmer, earthworker" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
